name: Bossa string cushion
desc: Soft string-section pad in Ab major for the bossa shelf: additive-partials ensemble tone holding maj7 and m9 cushions through the I-vi-ii-V, entering a hair behind each chord change like a Claus Ogerman arrangement; peak divides into gentle moving inner voices.

root.doc: semitone offset from Ab major home

code.peak: stack(note("[<[ab3,c4,eb4,g4] [f3,ab3,c4,eb4,g4] [bb3,db4,f4,ab4,c5] [eb4,g4,bb4,db5]>]*2").add(note("0,.07")).add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").attack(.25).decay(.6).sustain(.5).release(.7).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.85, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).shape(.22).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.6, ${gain}).fast(2)), note("<[~ c5@2 bb4] [~ ab4@2 g4] [~ f4@2 ab4] [~ bb4@2 db5]>").add(note(${root})).s("triangle").attack(.3).decay(.5).sustain(.4).release(.6).lpf(${cut}*1.4).gain(${gain}*.55).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(20))).room(.58).roomsize(5).pan(sine.range(.42,.58).slow(18)).orbit(6).play()
